Screenwriter Joe Eszterhas joins Joe Rogan for episode 2508. Eszterhas wrote Basic Instinct and other huge hits of his era. His scripts made him rich and famous in Hollywood.

He shares tales of stars, studios, and the deals behind the films. Rogan draws out stories of a wilder movie age. Eszterhas also reflects on illness and a changed life. The episode gives film buffs a legend's own account of his peak years. Few writers ever held his power, and he tells it like he knows it. His bluntness matches Rogan's own at every turn.

Dave Smith joins Tucker Carlson for a rapid-fire tour of Russia, Israel, Trump and the swamp, Obama, and media attacks on Joe Rogan. Smith, the libertarian comic behind Part of the Problem, treats nothing as sacred. His briefing spares no party and no president.

Smith gives his antiwar case on Russia and Israel in quick, sharp strokes. He revisits Obama's legacy and the press campaigns against Rogan and other independent voices. Carlson laughs along while steering the barrage. Bold and laughing viewers get a dissident comic's full clip, aimed at every seat of power.
